title: Interfaces for the finite polynomial system and normalized rank-one presentation
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, normed $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra fields $E,F$, an $E$-algebra structure on $F$, and $k,m\geq0$. All groups and sites use [def-weil-size-convention]. Put $J=\mathrm{Fin}(k+1)\sqcup\mathrm{Fin}(m)$, $I_n=\{d:J\to_0\mathbf N:\sum_i d_i\leq n\}$ and $G=\mathbf Z_\ell^k$. For $(g,t)\in G\times\mathbf Z_\ell$, its coordinates put $t$ first and then the coordinates of $g$. Define translation on $E[J]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] by replacing $y_i$ by $y_i-u_i$ and leaving $z_j$ fixed.

A PolynomialSystem consists of a system [def-sfb-ind-unipotent-system] over $E$ and $G$, injective $E$-linear embeddings of its stages in $E[J]$ with image exactly the polynomials supported in $I_n$, finiteness of $I_n$, and bases indexed by $I_n$ whose embedded vectors are the corresponding monomials. The embeddings intertwine successive transitions with inclusion, operators with minus the first formal derivative [def-weil-pbc-polynomial-partial-derivative], and actions with the displayed translations. The exponent at stage $n$ is $n+1$. Every action-matrix entry is the evaluation of an $E$-polynomial in the coordinates, and every such entry is continuous.

For such a system Q define tensorPolynomial on $F\otimes_E V_n$ by scalar extension of the polynomial embedding followed by the canonical polynomial tensor equivalence. For a polynomial translation Model T [def-sfb-polynomial-translation-model], polynomialSection sends a finite polynomial and a continuous coefficient section to the finite sum of the corresponding monomial coprojections multiplied by their scalar coefficients.

PresentationAssertion(Q,F) is the following specification. There is a continuous homomorphism $\pi:G\times\mathbf Z_\ell\to\mathbf Z_\ell^{k+1}$ whose coordinates are exactly the displayed splitting. For every T there is a continuous-section Presentation P [def-sfb-ind-unipotent-system], equivariant stage maps w into the inflation of T, underlying-module injections j indexed by I_n and projections p. The j form a finite coproduct, map under w to precisely T's monomial coprojections, and give the pure tensors of Q's basis on every continuous section. The p are exactly the coefficient projections of tensorPolynomial. The w commute with P's specified transitions. There is a colimit c of P both in actions and after forgetting the action, and an isomorphism c.pt to inflated T normalized by w on every stage. There are equivariant endomorphisms D, expD and delta of inflated T. D realizes the scalar-extended stage operators on every continuous section and minus the first derivative on each generalized monomial. expD realizes the stage action of the element (1,1) where the second 1 denotes additive one. delta=expD-id; on every section it is this group action minus identity, and on every generalized monomial it is the finite polynomial difference obtained by translation of y_1 by minus one. All generalized sections are taken on every profinite S, with coefficients in all continuous maps C(S,F); no completeness of F or common degree bound is imposed.
